issues.legal_issue: A consumer who opts for a refund after delayed delivery of an allotted flat is entitled to a refund with reasonable interest rather than being compelled to accept possession.
An award of 9% annual interest on the deposited amount from the dates of deposit until refund was fair and reasonable, whereas an award of 15% annual interest was excessive.
In the peculiar circumstances of the case, compensation for the loss suffered should be reduced from ₹10,00,000 to ₹7,50,000.
